concept: An adult astronomical instrument technician in a high-altitude observatory pauses before choosing between a crimson round narrowband filter cassette and a cyan square-edged cassette while the calibration slot remains empty.
reference_role: The attached conversation image is the sole appearance and adult-age reference for the main adult subject; it supplies no personality, relationship, or psychological meaning.
observable_requirements: two distinct and comparable physical filter cassettes visible at once
eye or head direction divided between the two alternatives
slight brow asymmetry or knitting with mild lip tension
a precision spectral loupe paused before touching either alternative
neither cassette selected and the calibration slot visibly empty
transport_recovery: The user reattached an exact local reference file. A single new built-in imagegen call used referenced_image_paths, with no conversation-image fallback.
